name: PHP Laravel
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git-lfs libpq-dev && sudo -E docker-php-ext-install pdo_pgsql && printf "\n" | sudo pecl install redis && sudo -E docker-php-ext-enable redis && sudo chmod a+x "$(pwd)" && sudo rm -rf /var/www/html && sudo ln -s "$(pwd)" /var/www/html && if [ -f composer.json ]; then composer install; npm install; fi && curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash && echo 'export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.config/composer/vendor/bin' >> ~/.bashrc && psql -c "CREATE USER $DB_USER WITH PASSWORD '$DB_PASSWORD' CREATEDB;" || true && psql -c "CREATE DATABASE $DB_NAME OWNER $DB_USER;" || true
